# Syrtis v1.2.0

**Syrtis now shows DeepSeek Harness (DSH) usage.**

- Syrtis reads DSH's session logs under `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\sessions`. DSH usage appears on its own DeepSeek Harness tab, with the DSH app icon. There is no limits card for DSH.

Thanks @kizaki-R for the engine support (tokscale-core#66).
